ENDLESS RESETS. QUESTIONABLE DECISIONS.

A fictional cosmic sandbox. No actual planets were harmed.

WELCOME TO YOUR LITTLE UNIVERSE

Go on.
Make a mess.

Pick a planet and a tool, then click or tap the surface to aim. The launch button targets the center. Every world has its own health pool. Chip away, mix your weapons, and finish it your way. Pause or slow time to watch the pieces fly.

Look around

Drag to orbit. Scroll or pinch to zoom. A drag won’t fire a weapon.

Freeze. Then shatter.

Launch an ice comet, then hit the frozen crust with a rock, railgun or drill for bonus damage. Frost fades, so make it count.

Keyboard controls

1–9 select a tool. Space fires. P pauses. R restores the planet.

Delightfully impossible

Damage, heat and gravity are game effects. Planets are displayed at a similar size; gas giants don’t really shatter into rocky pieces.

The ingredients

Three.js · MIT. Planet maps by Solar System Scope / INOVE · CC BY 4.0. Earth maps from three.js examples, with diffuse and city lights credited there to Sean Ward. Lighting and destruction are modified for the game.
